description: Defines the enum SavingsCompoundingInterestPeriodType, representing various time periods for interest compounding in the savings portfolio module of the Fineract project.

classes.name: SavingsCompoundingInterestPeriodType
classes.description: Enumeration of interest compounding periods for savings accounts, including methods to retrieve enum instances from integers and to get code/value pairs.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the integer value associated with the interest period type.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the string code associated with the interest period type.

methods.name: integerValues
methods.description: Returns an array of integer values for valid interest period types, excluding INVALID.

methods.name: fromInt
methods.description: Converts an integer to its corresponding SavingsCompoundingInterestPeriodType enum, defaulting to INVALID if no match is found.
